root_cause: Style.clear_meta_and_links() builds a copy with _link=None, _link_id='' and _meta=None but copies the cached hash (style._hash = self._hash). Style.__hash__ caches a value computed over _link and _meta, so the copy keeps a stale hash that belongs to the original style with link/meta.
best_solution: In Style.clear_meta_and_links set style._hash = None instead of copying self._hash, so the hash is recomputed lazily from the cleared fields. Reasoning from the statement: 'clearing meta' names clear_meta_and_links, 'hashed cache' names the _hash memo field; any field derived from attributes the method changes must be invalidated rather than copied.
acceptable_alternatives: Recomputing the hash eagerly for the new style would also pass, but the hidden test asserts clear_style._hash is None, so only lazy invalidation (None) satisfies it exactly.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_style.py::test_clear_meta_and_links_clears_hash: builds Style.parse('bold red on black link https://example.org') + Style.on(click='CLICK'), calls hash() to populate the cache, asserts style._hash is not None, then asserts style.clear_meta_and_links()._hash is None (private attribute checked directly, must be exactly None).
locating_signals: Title 'Clear hashed cache when clearing meta' maps to the method clear_meta_and_links and the _hash attribute in rich/style.py; the method is not named verbatim but grep for 'clear_meta' finds it in one hit. The statement is the PR description; the linked issue #2942 spells out the bug but is not needed.
our_outcome_summary: All four configs (v4, v6, v7, v8) passed in the Kaggle env with a patch identical to gold (style._hash = None). Pod runs 33-69 s, 14-39 tool calls; v8 used the most calls (39) for the same one-line fix.
generalizable_lesson: When a method returns a modified copy of an object that memoizes derived values (cached hash, _cache, lazy properties), reset every memo field whose inputs the method changed to its 'not computed' sentinel (usually None) rather than copying it; hidden tests often assert the sentinel directly on the private attribute.
